attributes.title: McSnow vertical profiles processed by NCL

reference.credit: Welss, Siewert and Seifert (2023), CC-BY-4.0; external member retained outside Git
reference.evidence: Archived author numerical calculations, not observations

evidence: One geometric capacitance sensitivity of a deterministic Earth source experiment, not a reconstruction of the archived executable or empirical validation.

intervention.other_terms: All source geometry, fall speed, atmosphere, ventilation and source distribution unchanged.
intervention.selection: Compact-sphere electrostatic capacitance, selected by the existing solid-sphere transition; no fit to archived profiles.

numerical_settings.first_step_rule: min(1e-4m,1e-3/max initial absolute d(log mass)/dz); subsequent adaptive controls unchanged
numerical_settings.invalid_trial_rule: Unrepresentable internal log-mass trial states return nonfinite RHS so DOP853 rejects and shrinks; no accepted state or physical mass is clipped

remaining: One intervention with baseline quadratures and tighter ODE tolerance; its full quadrature convergence is not separately established and no closure adoption follows.
